subject: Civic Education
competence: Contributes to the building of national cohesion and sustainable peace safeguarding one's own cultural identity
unique_learning_outcome: Expresses the importance of mutual understanding for the wellbeing of a peaceful society.
Explains the measures that can be taken for cultural integration in a multicultural society.
Explains the importance of respecting other cultural identity while retaining one's culture.
Explains the importance of building sustainable peace in a multicultural society.
Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development.
the_entrance: The concept of cultural diversity and its impact on national cohesion and sustainable peace

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of cultural diversity and its impact on national cohesion and sustainable peace
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes on the importance of mutual understanding for the wellbeing of a peaceful society
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment check on student understanding

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student practical group activities on cultural integration
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will work in groups to brainstorm measures for cultural integration in a multicultural society
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitates student presentations and synthesis of findings from Step 2.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students present their findings, compare outcomes, and note teacher feedback.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Teacher checks clarity of student presentations and corrects misconceptions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on cultural identity and respect
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present their findings on the importance of respecting other cultural identity while retaining one's culture
Students will answer targeted evaluation questions on the importance of building sustainable peace in a multicultural society
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet on cultural diversity and national cohesion
